name: io.github.codespar/mcp-payway
description: Payway (ex-Decidir) — Argentina card acquiring: tokenize, charge, capture, refund

environmentVariables.name: PAYWAY_PUBLIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Payway PUBLIC apikey — used only by create_token (card tokenization)

environmentVariables.name: PAYWAY_PRIVATE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Payway PRIVATE apikey — payments, captures, refunds and queries

environmentVariables.name: PAYWAY_ENV
environmentVariables.description: Environment: 'sandbox' or 'production'. Defaults to 'sandbox' (Decidir sandbox host).
